verdict.rationale: The pack never describes how a founder signs in to the CRA business account. It mentions 'your CRA account for business' but gives no MFA method, no remote-completion path, and nothing on whether a mailed PIN or in-person verification is required. The only documented sign-in is an EFILE number and password for electronic-filer transmitter accounts. That is a separate account type, and it shows no MFA, so it is adjacent evidence that does not deliver this story.
